-- Fix 74v2 (G4, blue/green): for a bigger redesign, build V2 next to V1, check it, then switch the
-- serving view in one statement. Users never see a half-built table. Drop V1 later.
create or replace dynamic table {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME_V2
  target_lag = '2 minutes' warehouse = {{WAREHOUSE}} refresh_mode = incremental
  comment = 'Blue/green V2: adds downtime per notification'
as select e.SITE, e.FLEET_TYPE, e.EQUIPMENT_ID, e.EQUIPMENT_NAME,
          date_trunc('month', n.CREATED_ON) as MONTH,
          count(*) as NOTIFICATIONS, sum(n.DOWNTIME_HOURS) as DOWNTIME_HOURS,
          round(sum(n.DOWNTIME_HOURS) / count(*), 2) as HOURS_PER_NOTIFICATION
   from {{DEMO_DB}}.L1.L1_MAINT_NOTIFICATION n
   join {{DEMO_DB}}.L1.L1_EQUIPMENT e on e.EQUIPMENT_ID = n.EQUIPMENT_ID
   group by all;

-- Check: V2 matches V1 on the shared columns (expect 0)
select count(*) as ROWS_DIFFERENT from (
  select SITE, EQUIPMENT_ID, MONTH, NOTIFICATIONS, DOWNTIME_HOURS from {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME
  minus
  select SITE, EQUIPMENT_ID, MONTH, NOTIFICATIONS, DOWNTIME_HOURS from {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME_V2);

-- Switch: one statement, instant for users
create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.SERVING.V_DOWNTIME
  comment = 'What users read: switched to V2 (blue/green)'
as select SITE, FLEET_TYPE, EQUIPMENT_ID, EQUIPMENT_NAME, MONTH, NOTIFICATIONS, DOWNTIME_HOURS
   from {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME_V2;

insert into {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG (SCENARIO, EVENT, GUARDRAIL, DETAIL, SOURCE)
values ('74v2', 'FIX_APPLIED', 'G4', 'Blue/green: DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME_V2 built and checked against V1, serving view switched in one statement', 'PRESENTER');
